## Read the evidence {#sec-current-evidence}

This page reads actual JSON/TOML files under `docs/data` at render time. It
does not execute the solver, infer a pass from source code, or assign historical
campaign results to this checkout. The source revision of this site is
**{{< var build.sha >}}**, rendered **{{< var build.rendered >}}**.

Inspect each record's source fingerprint, command, backend, hardware/platform,
timestamp, scope, exit status, and log. `NOT_RUN` means not measured;
`PASS` applies only to that command and source fingerprint. A later code change
can leave an earlier record stale even when this page renders successfully.

{{< prepared "validation" >}}

## Production and restart checks {#sec-production-evidence}

The end-to-end gate executes a full-physics cosmological smoke case and compares
every checkpointed field after four continuous steps against two steps followed
by a fresh-process restart to step four. This tests real launcher and checkpoint
behavior in addition to the operator suites. These short tests establish
installation and restart consistency; the science convergence matrix remains
necessary for a physical result.

```sh
julia --project=. -t 4 scripts/validate_production.jl --backend=cpu
julia --project=environments/metal -t 4 scripts/validate_production.jl --backend=metal
```

{{< prepared "production" >}}

## Reproduce or update {#sec-update-evidence}

```sh
julia --project=. -t auto scripts/validate.jl --backend=cpu
# On a Metal host, after Metal bootstrap:
julia --project=environments/metal -t auto scripts/validate.jl --backend=metal
# On an NVIDIA host, after CUDA bootstrap:
julia --project=environments/cuda -t auto scripts/validate.jl --backend=cuda
quarto render docs --fail-if-warnings
python3 docs/scripts/check_links.py docs/_site
```

`validation.json` aggregates the backend records;
`validation-{backend}.json` and `validation-{backend}.log` retain the individual
run evidence. Optional TOML records are also displayed. Failed runs and skipped
devices must not be relabeled as a successful extraction validation.

The documentation build accepts evidence without requiring a GPU, Julia,
external campaign directory, or numerical rerun. A green Pages build establishes
documentation/link integrity, not science certification.
